ui.settings.motivates.text: What QuestArc does to help, and what it does not do.
ui.settings.data.confirm: This removes your journeys, accepted stages and answers on all your devices. Your tasks stay. It cannot be undone.
ui.motivates.title: How QuestArc motivates you
ui.motivates.small-steps.title: Small steps that grow
ui.motivates.small-steps: A journey starts with a step small enough for your worst day. The next, slightly bigger step comes only when you choose to continue: reaching a station is not the same as the step feeling easy, so you can stay as long as you like, and your weekly answer suggests when. A step you already do can be passed; it shows as already yours and counts nothing.
ui.motivates.plan.title: One plan: after X, I will Y
ui.motivates.plan: Every step is tied to something you already do, like getting up. Doing it in the same situation is what turns it into a habit. Most simple habits take about two to five months, and it varies a lot.
ui.motivates.misses.title: One missed day is fine
ui.motivates.misses: A missed day is a gap, not a failure, and it costs nothing. Two in a row start a new run, but never end the journey. On hard days, the earlier, smaller step counts too.
ui.motivates.welcome-back.title: Welcome back
ui.motivates.welcome-back: Coming back after a gap is what matters most, so QuestArc greets it.
ui.motivates.break.title: After a long break
ui.motivates.break: When nothing has counted for two weeks, QuestArc asks how you would like to go on: carry on, call the time a pause, or take up the smaller step before again. Nothing you built is taken away, and the larger step waits for you. Two weeks is our choice; no study sets the number.
ui.motivates.reason.title: Your own reason
ui.motivates.reason: You can write down why you want the habit. QuestArc shows your words, never generic quotes.
ui.motivates.weekly.title: A weekly question
ui.motivates.weekly: Once a week QuestArc asks how automatic the habit feels. Later, your answers tell when a habit runs by itself.
ui.motivates.graduation.title: Habits stay yours
ui.motivates.graduation: Your tasks stay your tasks. When a journey ends, the habit keeps running as a normal task.
ui.motivates.game.title: Something grows
ui.motivates.game: Every journey builds something. It grows with your real progress, follows fixed rules and never loses a part.
ui.motivates.not.title: What QuestArc does not do
ui.motivates.not: No random rewards, no rankings, no punishment, no streaks that fall to zero, and no collecting of your data.
ui.motivates.success.title: Success
ui.motivates.success: Success is your habit, not how often you open QuestArc.
ui.pair.label: Pair it with
ui.pair.hint: Optional: something you enjoy and could save for this step, like "my podcast". Only you see this.

ui.setup.choose: QuestArc follows one recurring task for this station. You could create it now, or use a recurring task you already have.
ui.setup.waiting: Open the task, choose Schedule Task, then Repeat, and set it to: {schedule}. QuestArc picks it up by itself.

ui.setup.gone: The task for this station is gone. You could create a new one or use another recurring task.
ui.setup.earlier: Your earlier task stays as it is. You could end or change it in Super Productivity so you don't keep both, or use it again for this station.
ui.setup.skip: Is this already part of your day? You could pass this station. It shows as already yours and counts nothing.
ui.pick.title: Use an existing task
ui.pick.none: You have no recurring tasks that a journey can follow yet.
ui.pick.supported: Only tasks that repeat daily, every few days or on chosen weekdays are listed.

ui.continue.earlier: Next you set up the task for this station. Your earlier task stays as it is.
ui.continue.again: This is the step you left to start smaller. It kept what it counted, and the days in between do not count.
ui.continue.choice: Both are fine. Staying costs nothing: everything keeps counting, and you can continue whenever you like.
ui.continue.suggest-stay: This step still takes some thought. You could give it another week.
ui.continue.suggest-new: This step is still new. You could give it another week.
ui.continue.suggest-continue: This step seems to come by itself now. You could go on.

ui.welcome.title: Welcome to QuestArc
ui.welcome.what: QuestArc turns a habit into a journey of small steps.
ui.welcome.how: You keep using your normal tasks; QuestArc shows what grows from them.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.data.title: Your data
ui.settings.data.text: QuestArc stores only your choices (journeys, accepted stages, answers) with your Super Productivity data. Removing the plugin deletes them on all your devices.
ui.error.starting: QuestArc is starting. This page updates by itself in a moment.
ui.error.not-running: QuestArc is not running. Check that it is switched on in Settings → Plugins, then reload Super Productivity.
ui.error.failed: QuestArc could not read your data. It tries again every few seconds. If this message stays, reload Super Productivity.
ui.error.gone: This page is out of date: the journey or station changed. Go back to continue.
ui.error.write: QuestArc could not save this. Please try again.
ui.build.title: What you build
ui.build.keeps: You can change this any time. What you have built stays and is drawn as your new choice.
ui.settings.panel: Show the build in the side panel
ui.settings.panel.text: On this device only. QuestArc gets a button next to the play button that opens it beside your tasks. Turning it off takes effect the next time Super Productivity starts.
